bubble.actionGuideeHint: Click the highlighted element to continue

start.label: Show me where
start.description: {{copilot}} highlights the spot in question, without doing anything on your behalf.

retour.title: Tell us what went wrong
retour.body: This button is on every screen. It opens a direct report, with **a copy of the screen** you are on.

helpCenter.title: Help and guides
helpCenter.description: {{copilot}} shows you where things are, screen by screen. Nothing is done on your behalf: you read, you close whenever you like.
helpCenter.needsAccount: Open an account file, then start this guide again from here.
helpCenter.settingsDescription: Screen-by-screen guides: {{copilot}} shows where things are, without doing anything on your behalf.

retour-comment-le-signaler.title: Report what's wrong
retour-comment-le-signaler.summary: The feedback button, on every screen, with a copy of your screen.

analyser-un-compte.title: Analyze an account
analyser-un-compte.summary: Name a company and prepare its conquest file.

composer.title: Name the company
composer.body: Type its name and, if you like, your intent: the offer to place, the person to reach. The more precise the context, the more precise the file.

preparer.title: Prepare, then confirm
preparer.body: This button prepares the analysis. Nothing is launched or charged until you confirm at the next step.

lire-un-dossier-compte.title: Read an account file
lire-un-dossier-compte.summary: The action to take now, the sections of the file, and their content.

action.title: Your next action
action.body: This button changes with the file's state: complete the analysis, read the brief, prepare the first message…

sections.title: The sections of the file
sections.body: Contacts, org chart, attack angles, action plan: each section reads on its own.

contenu.title: The section's content
contenu.body: What is known shows here; **what couldn't be found** is said, never made up.

construire-ses-cibles.title: Build your targets
construire-ses-cibles.summary: Create a list of accounts to work on and follow it.

creer.title: Create a list
creer.body: Give it a name and, if you like, a goal. You add accounts from their file or from Discover.

listes.title: Your lists
listes.body: Your lists and their accounts live here. An empty list stays empty: nothing is added without you.

decouvrir-des-comptes.title: Discover accounts
decouvrir-des-comptes.summary: Look for new accounts from criteria.

recherche.title: Set your criteria
recherche.body: A sector, a size, a region, a technology: pick the ideal account's criteria, or ask {{copilot}}.

lancer.title: Run the search
lancer.body: The search starts on your click, never by itself.

resultats.title: The results
resultats.body: Accounts found show here. You choose the ones that join your targets.

travailler-avec-laura.title: Work with {{copilot}}
travailler-avec-laura.summary: Ask a question, prepare a message, review an account with {{copilot}}.

fil.title: The conversation
fil.body: {{copilot}} answers here and cites what she relies on. She prepares, you decide: she never sends an email on your behalf.

saisie.title: Ask your question
saisie.body: Write as you would to a colleague: "prepare a message for the CIO", "what changed on this account?".

suivre-ses-actions.title: Follow your actions
suivre-ses-actions.summary: Find what was done, by whom, and when.

filtres.title: Filter the log
filtres.body: By period, type or account: narrow the log to what you are looking for.

journal.title: The log
journal.body: Every action stays traced here. An action marked "done" is a declaration, not a proof of sending.

lire-sa-boite-mail.title: Read your mailbox
lire-sa-boite-mail.summary: Your mailbox threads, linked to your accounts.

fils.title: Your threads
fils.body: Threads from your connected mailbox show here. With no mailbox connected, this is where you connect it.

rechercher.title: Search a thread
rechercher.body: Find a thread by keyword or by contact.

projets-et-besoins.title: Projects and needs
projets-et-besoins.summary: Your clients' projects and the needs to staff.

vues.title: Switch views
vues.body: Go from projects to needs, and back.

contenu.title: The detail
contenu.body: The chosen view's projects and needs show here.

piloter-ses-missions.title: Steer your missions
piloter-ses-missions.summary: Running missions, their planning and their invoicing.

vues.title: Two views
vues.body: "Ongoing" ranks your missions; "Planning" lays them out over time; "Invoicing" shows what can be prepared as an invoice. An invoice is prepared here, never issued.

contenu.title: Your missions
contenu.body: The chosen view shows here, with its filters.

brancher-ses-outils.title: Connect your tools
brancher-ses-outils.summary: Connect CRM, mailbox and calendar, or import a file.

recherche.title: Find a tool
recherche.body: Search for the tool your team already uses.

importer.title: Or import a file
importer.body: No connector? Import your accounts or contacts from a file.

importer-ses-donnees.title: Import your data
importer-ses-donnees.summary: Bring in a file of accounts or contacts, step by step.

assistant.title: The import assistant
assistant.body: Choose the source, drop the file, check the column mapping. Nothing is written before you validate.

etapes.title: Where you are
etapes.body: The import steps and the ones already done.

tes-contacts-deja-connus.title: Your contacts, already known
tes-contacts-deja-connus.summary: People imported, enriched or already in your workspace — never a market search.

page.title: Your contacts, already known
page.body: This page gathers the people already imported, enriched or present in your workspace. To look for new people on the market, use Discover.

recherche.title: See the contacts ready to work
recherche.body: The lifecycle filter and search narrow the list down to the ones waiting for an action from you.

premier-succes-bellumai.title: First {{brand}} win
premier-succes-bellumai.summary: The first thing to do with {{copilot}}, right after the questionnaire.

saisie.title: Your audit is ready — your turn
saisie.body: Ask {{copilot}}: "prepare my first message" or "which account should I target first?". She answers from what you just told her.

vivier-de-talents.title: Your talent pool
vivier-de-talents.summary: The consultants you already know — the starting point for any matching. Search, filters, and three ways to add one.

vues.title: One screen, quick views
vues.body: "Talents" lists your consultants; the quick views (available within 30 days, on the bench, to reconnect with…) filter the list in one click. "Submissions" is a collapsible section further down the same page.

ajouter.title: Add a consultant
ajouter.body: A form filled by hand, a dropped CV, or an import — three doors to fill your talent pool.
